therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Parkinson's disease patients previously treated with ropinirole
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Safety and tolerability measures including cardiovascular parameters, laboratory values, and physical/neurological examination findings after switching from ropinirole to rotigotine transdermal patch over 28 days

results.effect_size: Minimal clinically relevant changes in cardiovascular parameters (e.g., supine systolic BP change +5.7 mmHg, heart rate change +0.5 bpm); 99/124 patients completed the trial; 0 dropouts during 5 half-life overlap period due to AEs
biomarker_changes: Mean change in platelet count: +2.6 Giga/l
Mean change in white blood cell count: -0.045 Giga/l
Mean change in alkaline phosphatase: -1.4 Units/l
Mean change in uric acid: -3.80 µmol/l
subgroup_findings: CGI Item 3.1 (Therapeutic Effect): 3 marked, 20 moderate, 36 minimal, 54 unchanged or worse
CGI Item 3.2 (Side Effects): 88 none, 18 no significant interference, 5 significant interference, 2 outweigh therapeutic effect
PGI Item 2 (Therapeutic Effect): 5 marked, 25 moderate, 38 minimal, 44 unchanged or worse
PGI Item 3 (Side Effects): 77 no side effects, 24 no significant interference, 6 significant interference, 5 outweighing therapeutic effect
Patient preference: 52 of 112 preferred patch over oral (Strongly Agree + Agree), 31 disagreed or strongly disagreed
Most liked aspect of patch: applying once a day (81 patients)
Most disliked aspect: did not stay on for entire day (80 patients)
safety_signals: 9 patients dropped out due to AEs with onset during the 5 half-life overlap period
1 patient required dose reduction due to AEs with onset during the 5 half-life overlap period
1 clinically relevant dermatological finding in physical examination
1 clinically relevant gait abnormality in neurological examination
1 clinically relevant involuntary movements finding in neurological examination

dose_info.dose_modifications: 1 patient required dose reduction during 5 half-life overlap period due to AEs

context.comparator: ropinirole (prior treatment, not concurrent control arm)
context.duration: 28 days treatment with up to 56 days follow-up for AEs with onset during overlap period

results_by_chain.endpoint: Safety and tolerability (cardiovascular, laboratory, physical/neurological examination)
